(remove-ai-stream-methods..., move-maxsteps-to-stopwhen.ts, rename-mock-v2-to-v3.ts) or a lib factory that returns it (remove-await-streamtext.ts via removeAwaitFn); the exempt items are the definition, the factories and add-comment's helper, so nothing is left to count. reason: All exported consts in src/v1 carry the spec prefix (harnessV1...Schema in bridge-protocol.ts, diagnostic.ts, stream-part.ts; HARNESS_V1_BUILTIN_TOOLS in builtin-tool.ts), a deliberate namespacing of the public v1 spec re-exported from v1/index.ts; no lint rule enforces it, so an unprefixed new export is worth flagging. label: ACCEPT
reason: Exported zod schemas are consistently named *Schema, and the matching type keeps the plain name (harnessPromptContentSchema / HarnessPromptContent in extract-harness-prompt-content.ts, harnessV1DebugConfigSchema in harness-v1-diagnostic.ts). With the non-schema constants exempt (BOOTSTRAP_SCHEMA_VERSION, DEFAULT_PERMISSION_MODE, HARNESS_V1_BUILTIN_TOOLS) nothing is left to count, and a new schema without the suffix is worth flagging. Hesitated with WRONG mixed_group: the scope also holds recurring non-schema exports (tools, an array of schemas, constants), and 'plain values (literals or built-ins only)' does not describe all of them, so the wording is unclear.
